name: Ultimaker 3

outputs.reason: Ultimaker 3 export is not implemented. Its Griffin header, startup handoff and shutdown need a machine-specific contract; the S5 startup is not assumed compatible.

startup.validation: Standard-height Ultimaker 3, not Extended or S3. No UM3 startup handoff has been established.

boundsBasis: Cura uses a 233 x 215 x 200 mm coordinate envelope; the advertised single-nozzle volume is 215 x 215 x 200 mm. Both tools use a conservative shared rectangle x=18..208, y=10..207, inside their overlap and excluding Cura's front-right and glass-clip regions. This rectangle is not the full single-tool area.
processBasis: PLA is an editable default; ABS is also declared. Flow/retraction caps are conservative SAAM choices. Select one installed AA 0.4 core per plan. A right-hand BB core must not be selected as AA. In-program tool changes, PVA/BB recipes and nonplanar clearance are not declared. Changing material also requires the matching material GUID before eventual Griffin output.
validation: Profile for geometry and setup review only; machine output and physical printing are unvalidated.
